easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
description:
Activate Marvin using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands you control.
Activate the two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
